Top frame: the 60" boards span the legs' long side (53 + 2 × 3 1/2 = 60) and the 42" boards end at their outside edges, so 42 = leg width + 2 × 1 1/2 (2x4 thickness, §9) → leg width 39, not 39 1/2; the 42" boards come out 1/2" short (39 1/2 + 3 = 42 1/2).
